action.objective: Verify Nxc7: capture the queen on c7, then assess Bxc7 and follow-up with Qa3/Bxc7 recapture.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 gave exact +43 for b5c7 with PV b5c7 f4c7 d3a3, the only exact row. Black's f4 bishop is loose; Nxc7 wins the queen for a bishop. Single-candidate verification to depth 4 within the reserved 2000 nodes to check Black replies and mate safety.
